headline: Six Fronts See Heavy Fighting Base Turnovers Rise
war_summary: Since the 06:06 edition the war's hottest sectors have kept bleeding while the front line remains largely frozen elsewhere. Weathered Expanse still leads the butcher's bill with roughly 7,000 Colonial and 8,100 Warden losses in the last day, though hourly loss rates have eased. Nevish Line continues to hemorrhage — over 4,700 Colonial and 4,400 Warden casualties — and its casualty curves are also cooling. Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand each recorded another thirty‑plus base‑ownership changes in the past 24 hours; Kuura Strand shows a sharp enlistment surge. Linn Mercy has accelerated sharply, posting 83 Colonial and 182 Warden casualties per hour in the most recent window. Godcrofts saw a base turn neutral early this morning, the only fresh turnover there. Farranac Coast logged two captures yesterday, while Pari Peak, Olavis Wake, Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf each recorded a handful of ownership flips. Dead Lands and Callahans Passage remain casualty‑heavy but report no base changes. Enlistment spikes persist in the most contested zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
